tips.text: Bank Aya before Grendel Prime returns to Prime Resurgence; neither Aya nor relics expire when her stock rotates.
Buy extra Blueprint relics; every one carries Grendel Prime Blueprint as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab in the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine relics to Radiant for 100 Void Traces each where your part is Rare; leave Common ones Intact, since Radiant lowers their odds.
Run Radiant relics in a radshare squad when you are after the Rare part.
Pick the same reward as a teammate at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
